items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Zuttty was with Roy too. Yeah, Zuttty was out there with Roy. I jammed with so many guys around there then... I got to play with a lot -- almost every guy around Chicago then

ctx.x: So, yeah, I fooled around with Roy. And what's his name was with Roy too. What's the bass player around Chicago? I can't think of -- he plays -- played with Lunceford later. What -- I can't think of his name now. But anyway they were with Roy. Zuttty was with Roy too. Yeah, Zuttty was out there with Roy.

I jammed with so many guys around there then, man. A lot of -- there were a lot of good players around Chicago. None of them were really making any money. So, you know, during the summer, why, we just -- anybody had a gig. Say, well, look I got a gig tomorrow night over there. Don't pay a lot but it'd pay about ten, fifteen bucks. I says sure. Well, you know, you have nothing. So, it's a little money. And this is what we did -- all of us played with different guys. I got to play with a lot -- almost every guy…
